V-IF-S-001.verification: Verify hardware authentication mechanism — test cryptographic handshake between interface and connected device

V-IF-T-001.verification: Physical tamper inspection — verify tamper-evident seals and enclosure integrity

V-IF-R-001.verification: Review interface access logs — confirm timestamps and event records are present and tamper-proof

V-IF-I-001.verification: Verify data encryption on physical bus — capture traffic and confirm ciphertext only

V-IF-D-001.verification: Test interface resilience — apply electrical stress and verify protection mechanisms activate

V-IF-E-001.verification: Verify debug interface is disabled — attempt JTAG/SWD connection and confirm access is denied

V-IF-E-002.verification: Verify firmware signature enforcement — attempt to flash unsigned image and confirm rejection

V-IF-POLICY-001.verification: Verify interface access policy — confirm interface is inaccessible outside declared maintenance window

V-IF-DBG-001.verification: Verify debug interface access control — confirm authentication is required and command set is restricted to minimum

V-IF-MON-001.verification: Verify interface monitoring is active — confirm access events are logged and alerts are generated on anomalies
